mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_auth_info ( email, auth_num, expired_dt, use_yn, reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{authNum}, #{expiredDt}, #{useYn}, #{regDt} )
mapper.select: SELECT e.mail_auth_seq, e.email, e.auth_num, e.expired_dt, e.use_yn FROM email_auth_info e WHERE e.email = #{email} AND e.use_yn = 'Y'
